home.hero.eyebrow: Built for Libya. Ready for wherever life goes.
home.hero.title: The real rate. *Finally.*
home.hero.lead: Your dinars, dollars and digital assets in one place. Move money with people you trust, at a rate you can see before you commit.
home.hero.note: Pre-launch. Services depend on regulatory approval and partner availability.
home.hero.alt: tazdan home showing balances, contacts and assets
home.pain.title: Your money should not take *the long way home.*
home.pain.lead: A queue, a middleman or a rate you only learn at the end: familiar problems deserve a clearer way through.
home.pain.1.before: The quoted dollar rate changes before you reach the counter.
home.pain.1.after: See the live rate and the full quote before you exchange.
home.pain.2.before: Getting paid means sharing bank details with someone you barely know.
home.pain.2.after: Share your @handle or QR code. Your bank details stay yours.
home.pain.3.before: Money sent home passes through a chain of promises.
home.pain.3.after: Track a transfer from a locked quote to payout, where a corridor is available.
home.pain.4.before: A cash trade puts you face to face with a stranger.
home.pain.4.after: Browse P2P offers with escrow, dispute support and privacy controls.
home.rate.title: Know the rate *before you move.*
home.rate.lead: Compare the live rate, review the amount you receive and confirm only when it makes sense for you. Prices can move; a quote is shown before you act.
home.rate.alt: tazdan buy screen with rate and amount review
home.everything.title: The tools you need, *close at hand.*
home.everything.lead: The app brings everyday payments, exchange, goals and business money together. Each feature page shows what is built, in pilot or planned.
home.everything.move.title: Pay by @handle
home.everything.move.body: Send to a contact, scan a code or make a claim link for someone who has not joined yet.
home.everything.exchange.title: Exchange with context
home.everything.exchange.body: Hold multiple currencies, follow live prices and review the rate before buying or selling.
home.everything.save.title: Save toward something real
home.everything.save.body: Give a goal a name, add to it on a schedule and track progress in the app.
home.everything.business.title: Pay your team together
home.everything.business.body: Business accounts bring roles, batch payouts, approvals and an API into one workspace.
home.safety.title: Private by design. *Accountable by default.*
home.safety.lead: A @handle keeps your bank details out of everyday payments. Identity checks, transaction screening and a balanced ledger help protect the money behind them.
home.safety.funds.title: Money has a record
home.safety.funds.body: Customer balances move through balanced ledger entries, with reserved funds tracked for pending actions.
home.safety.privacy.title: Your details stay yours
home.safety.privacy.body: Hide balances on screen. P2P shows a first name and last initial; nearby discovery shares only approximate distance.
home.safety.security.title: Confirm with confidence
home.safety.security.body: Two-factor and risk-based checks protect sensitive actions; activity and device controls help you spot what changed.
home.business.title: Payday, *without the pile of envelopes.*
home.business.lead: Preview a batch, reserve the funds and have another team member approve larger payouts. The same record is there for your books.
home.business.alt: tazdan Business screen with payouts and quick actions
home.tour.title: See how it *feels to use.*
home.tour.lead: Move through eight parts of the app. These screens use illustrative account data from the current build.
home.tour.home.title: Your money, at a glance.
home.tour.home.body: Swipe from your total to each currency. Contacts and recent activity are within reach.
home.tour.home.alt: Home screen with balance, contacts and asset rows
home.tour.send.title: A person, not an account number.
home.tour.send.body: Choose a contact or @handle, review the details and confirm the transfer.
home.tour.remit.title: Know the path home.
home.tour.remit.body: Pilot corridors show a locked quote, recipient and progress through payout.
home.tour.remit.alt: Remittance screen showing a transfer route
home.tour.p2p.title: Trade with more context.
home.tour.p2p.body: See offers, completion history and approximate distance before opening a trade.
home.tour.save.title: Make room for a plan.
home.tour.save.body: Create a savings goal, schedule contributions and watch it take shape.
home.tour.chat.title: Keep the conversation together.
home.tour.chat.body: Talk, request and pay inside the same chat.
home.tour.privacy.title: Keep your numbers to yourself.
home.tour.privacy.body: Hide balances on screen and share a handle instead of bank details.
home.tour.business.title: One place for the team.
home.tour.business.body: Business payouts, roles and API access live in a dedicated workspace.
